_comment: Hand-read corrections: { font: { glyphId: text } } for fonts that are not in a reference file. The advance width is read from the PDF's copy of the font.  is the i-matra placeholder (see js/text/lost-glyphs.js). Poppins-SemiBold is the title font of the UPSC Wallah books; Baloo2-SemiBold 1581 is the empty zero-width glyph the font places after an i-matra+reph glyph (the PDF's text map gives it the whole syllable, which would duplicate letters).
